samples.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished FULL-SCREEN 16:9 landscape visual SAMPLE of a playable Hindi sentence adventure for a six-year-old, not a poster, not a worksheet. Premium coherent 2.5D / softly realistic 3D cartoon adventure art, warm wood, natural greens, blue water, soft sunlight, matching material rendering across environment and objects. Background sparse, subdued and slightly soft; large crisp words and interactive objects are the main visual focus. Original adventure world, no existing cartoon logos/characters. Swifty is the white baby bird in reference image 1: preserve its white head, big blue eyes, yellow hoodie with smiley, blue shorts and brown cross-body satchel. Small at left of playable area. Only minimal interface: small folded-map icon top-left, small speaker top-right, six small progress dots near top-right. No app frame, browser, scoreboards, instruction paragraphs, headings, English, numbers, captions, title text or watermarks. All visible Hindi must be perfectly legible dark navy rounded bold Devanagari with generous spacing. Show an actual mid-game state awaiting the child's answer. Render only one full game screen. Reference image2 is the approved rendering and layout quality anchor; match mascot design, typography, warm tangible materials, color palette and lighting. Do not copy its bridge scene for other levels. ADVENTURE MAP sample screen, same 3D art direction as reference2. An inviting compact grassy valley viewed from elevated 3/4 overhead, with ONE winding sandy trail connecting SIX distinct miniature landmarks sequentially: wooden river bridge at lower-left, stone-arched wooden locked door at middle-left, three-way path fork near upper-left, gentle blue cave near upper-middle, wooden hillside staircase at upper-right, cottage with garden gate at lower-right as destination. Swifty stands at start next to bridge. Use six small circular golden route nodes, first glows, remaining muted, dotted path continuous between landmarks; no text, no numbers, no question panels or answer choices. Keep map very clean with broad soft-green terrain, few rounded trees confined to edges, softblue river ONLY by first bridge. Full-screen map composed of large tangible harmonious 3D assets, easily understood by a six-year-old. Small folded-map icon and speaker can remain. Avoid busy forests and decorative flowers. No railway. This is a navigational map, not a gameplay quiz screen.
